from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# 2006-01-27 was a Friday
start_date = datetime(2006, 1, 27)

# Add 986 days
end_date = start_date + timedelta(days=986)

# Get the day of the week
# weekday() returns 0-6 where 0 is Monday, 6 is Sunday
day_names = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday']
day_name = day_names[end_date.weekday()]

print(f"ANSWER: {day_name}")
